headline: Fitch Revises France’s Credit Outlook to Negative on Debt Dynamics
summary: Fitch Ratings revised France’s sovereign credit outlook to 'negative' citing worsening debt dynamics.
why: Sovereign credit rating outlook revisions serve as an early warning for potential rating downgrades, which can increase government borrowing costs and affect European bond markets.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: Fitch revised France's outlook to negative based on debt dynamics.
